episodes.synopsis:
Shinra is overwhelmed and loses consciousness. The next time he wakes, he's tied down in an unfamiliar room.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: With the Sun at His Back
episodes.synopsis:
Fire soldiers race out to fight two pillars at once. Benimaru spots a certain Infernal near one of the two.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Birth
episodes.synopsis:
Gazing up at a strange moon, Licht has several realizations. Sho strives to find out about his family.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Savior
episodes.synopsis:
The last pillar appears. As the 2nd battles, nightfall brings darkness and despair. Then, a ray of light...

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: At the Center of the World
episodes.synopsis:
Shinra, Sho, and Iris have vanished! The 8th sets out to look for them and someone unexpected offers to help.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Incantation of Destruction
episodes.synopsis:
The 8th marches on Amaterasu. Vulcan's team investigates inside while the rest hold the White Clad at bay.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Those Who Fight Back
episodes.synopsis:
Dr. Giovanni has become an Infernal and taken over Yu's body. He inserts the key into Amaterasu's power generator and triggers the Great Cataclysm. When he does, the world and the images of Adolla begin to merge into one, and large-scale fires break out all over the Empire. As cries of despair rise from the people, the Special Fire Force soldiers are powerless, with no course of action left.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Where Hope Is
episodes.synopsis:
Colossal fires throw the Tokyo Empire into chaos. Cries of despair from the people spread until they threaten to swallow the Fire Force soldiers, too. At that moment, Obi encourages his comrades to rise up. His words get the fire soldiers get back on their feet, and they begin rescue operations to bring hope to the people. Then, as if to mock them, demons who bring despair to the world appear.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Dragon and Knight Surge Toward the Heavens
episodes.synopsis:
Seeking to settle the score from their last meeting, Arthur challenges Dragon to battle alone. Their fight rages over land, sea, and air. And then, they travel to the surface of the strange moon. In the airless vacuum and extreme cold, Arthur desperately fights back, but then, at last, he collapses. The fate of the world hangs on this battle. Will the Knight King, Arthur, be able to win?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Hero Resurrected
episodes.synopsis:
Arthur has exorcised the great despair. Just as everyone wonders if the Great Cataclysm has stopped, the moon begins falling toward Earth. At the same time, Kurono and Joker face off against their doppelgangers. And then, the "strongest demon" also appears.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Despair Saintess
episodes.synopsis:
Shinra and Sho confront Haumea in Adolla. Haumea believes that humanity's collective unconscious harbors a wish for death. She kills Inca and Sumire right in front of Shinra and Sho. The brothers reject Haumea's words and launch an attack, but for some reason, their blows don't reach her.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Answer
episodes.synopsis:
Shinra's rage and despair spark the transformation of the earth into a second sun. With humanity's wish fulfilled, Haumea prays for her own death. Shinra faces her with a demonic expression, intent on killing her. Then, a huge flash of light strikes from space! The battle between the saintess (Haumea) and the hero (Shinra) reaches its climax!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Hero's Tale
episodes.synopsis:
Shinra Bansho Man revives the world, bringing back all of the dead, and that seems to be that. But the world has changed. Shinra Bansho Man has turned death into something familiar and friendly. When he says to live life to the fullest Haumea rejects him and the world, and tries to choose despair yet again. Then, Death appears. This scorching dark fantasy led by flames now comes to an end!

(Source: Crunchyroll)
